 AI-Driven Salesforce-Marketo Integration Engineer
Location - Seattle (Hybrid) 

At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.  
  
 Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive. 

 F5 is seeking an innovative, highly skilled AI-Driven Salesforce-Marketo Integration Engineer to join our Marketing Technologies team within the Digital organization. This unique role sits at the intersection of marketing and engineering, with a dual focus: 
 Transforming our marketing workflows by infusing AI into pivotal processes such as content creation, campaign optimization, publishing, analytics, and more.  
 Owning, maintaining, and optimizing the data integration, schema alignment, and sync reliability between Adobe Marketo Engage and Salesforce (SFDC) 
    
 Primary Responsibilities  
 Data Sync & Integration Architecture: Configure, monitor, and maintain bidirectional and unidirectional synchronization between Marketo and Salesforce across leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, campaigns, custom objects, and activities. 
 Schema, Field Mapping : Create and manage field mappings, datatype updates, schema changes, and Marketo Sales Insight (MSI) configurations while preventing field drift and cross-system conflicts 
 Troubleshooting & Incident Response: Diagnose and resolve sync bottlenecks, API rate/validation errors, duplicate records, and campaign data discrepancies; lead root-cause analysis and preventive fixes 
 Sandbox & Lifecycle Management: Support sandbox refreshes, configuration audits, asset restoration, and sync re-establishment across development and production environments 

 Secondary Responsibilities 
 Collaborate closely with marketing teams across content creation, brand, vertical content, SEO, analytics, and publishing functions to identify opportunities for AI integration.  
 Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications and intelligent agents tailored to marketing use cases.  
 Enhance marketing workflows through automation and data-driven insights leveraging advanced AI tools and techniques.  
 
 Experience and Skills:  

 A minimum of 3 years (5+ preferred) of hands-on experience with Adobe Marketo Engage and Salesforce CRM administration/integration, including Marketo–SFDC sync architecture and troubleshooting 
 Strong understanding of CRM/MAP data models, field mappings, API integrations, smart campaigns/lists, lead lifecycle/scoring/routing, and data hygiene practices 
 Proven ability to partner with RevOps, Salesforce, and Data/Analytics teams on reporting accuracy, attribution, and compliance 
 Proven hands-on expertise in marketing workflows including content creation, campaign strategy, analytics, SEO, and publishing.   
 In-depth understanding of the business and technical challenges faced by marketers.  
 Minimum of 5 years of software development experience, with a demonstrated ability to write, debug, and optimize complex code.  
 Proficiency in developing AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, and workflows leveraging technologies such as natural language processing (NLP), machine learning (ML), automation frameworks, and big data platforms.   
 
 AI Proficiency:  
 LLM Orchestration & Agent Architectures: Hands-on experience building  and deploying autonomous agentic workflows and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines using modern orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or similar)   
 API & LLM Integration: Strong proficiency consuming, securing, and optimizing enterprise LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini Enterprise, or similiar). Experience in setting up guardrails.  
 AI-Driven Marketing Use Cases: Practical understanding of applying generative AI for automated content generation, semantic SEO/GEO optimization, predictive campaign insights, and campaign workflow automation  
 
 Soft Skills:  
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively across diverse teams.  
 Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate marketing challenges into technical solutions.  
 Demonstrated ability to drive projects from concept to completion.  
 Preferred Qualifications:  
 Working knowledge of the Gemini Enterprise Platform.  
 Familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and their application to marketing problems.  
 Experience leveraging AI to optimize marketing workflows and their orchestration.   
 Work Environment  
 The AI-Driven Salesforce-Marketo Integration Engineer  will report to the Director of Marketing Technologies and work in close collaboration with cross-functional marketing teams.  
 Join us at F5 and lead the AI transformation in marketing workflows that drives impactful business results! 
  
 #LI-HB1 
 
 The Job Description is intended to be a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the job. However, the description may not be all-inclusive, and responsibilities and requirements are subject to change.
 
The annual base pay for this position is: $179,500.00 - $269,300.00 
 F5 maintains broad salary ranges for its roles in order to account for variations in knowledge, skills, experience, geographic locations, and market conditions, as well as to reflect F5’s differing products, industries, and lines of business. The pay range referenced is as of the time of the job posting and is subject to change. 
 
 You may also be offered incentive compensation, bonus, restricted stock units, and benefits. More details about F5’s benefits can be found at the following link:  https://www.f5.com/company/careers/benefits . F5 reserves the right to change or terminate any benefit plan without notice.
